segments.text: BISM ALLAH ARRAHMAN ARRAHIM My dear lucky viewers, Al-Salaamu ‘Alaykum
This tape will present to you how to observe the Contact Prayer, the Salat.
And you are very lucky because you are trying to learn how to make contact with your creator,
which is the greatest of all worships.
In this tape, I will explain to you the meaning of the word Salat.
You already heard me call it contact.
The word Salat (‏صلاة) is an Arabic word derived from the root Silah (صلة),
which means connection or contact. So, when you observe the Salat prayers, you make contact
with your creator.
It is wrong to translate it as pray.
As a Muslim, when you tell somebody “I pray five times a day”, that is the wrong expression,
because other people can tell you “I pray all day.”
The correct expression for the Muslim is “I make contact with my creator five times a
day.”
This is the meaning of Salat.
In this program, I will present to you where the Salat commandment comes from.
The Contact Prayer is mention in the Quran more than seventy times.
And I will show you the crucial verses, like where the times of Contact Prayers are mentioned
in the Quran.
Then, I will go on to explain to you the source of the Contact Prayers.
When was the first time that the contact commandment came to us from God? And how did it come to
our generation? I will explain this to you.
Then, I will move on to explain why does God want us to establish contact with Him.
Why did God command us to observe the Contact Prayers five times a day?
What is the reason?
Does God need the Contact Prayers, or do we need the Contact Prayers?
After this, I will go on to explain every aspect of the Contact Prayer.
I’m gonna start with the call for the Contact Prayer, the Azan (أَذَان).

that a woman who has her period or menstruation cannot pray.
Now, this has to be from Satan because Satan is the one who does not want you, the Muslim

God did not say in the Quran at all “do not pray during menstruation.”
There is nothing in the Quran that says that.

segments.text: BISMI ALLAH AL-RAHMAN AL-RAHIM. In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
Brothers and sisters AL-Salãmu ‘Alaykum. The Friday congregational prayer is an
obligatory duty upon every Muslim man and woman. This is a social function
decreed by God Almighty for the Muslims to get together and to know each other
and to be familiar with their problems and their joys. And we find in SURA
number 62 verse number 9, the commandment from God says o you who believe when the
contact prayers, the SALAT for Friday, is announced, you shall go to the mosque and
observe the SALAT prayer, and drop all business. This is better for
you if you only knew. So, if anyone is afraid that he or she may lose some
business during the Friday prayer, God is saying this should be better for you
God will make it up to you. God runs the world and He is the only
provider and He guarantees you doing better if you go to the Friday prayer.
And notice that the commandment said o you who believe.
It didn't say o you believing men or o you believing women. It says o you who
believe when the contact prayer on Friday is called for, you shall go and
drop all business. It is very important. I'm emphasizing the role of the women
because this is also an educational meeting where people sit down and
listen to a sermon and the Muslim woman must be the best educated because she
teaches the children. Women are our mothers and they teach
us as we grow up and it is essential that they are educated, not ignorant.
The traditional customary Muslims of the Middle East, they kept the women away
from the mosque and this kept the children ignorant because the mothers
are ignorant as far as the religion is concerned. So, it is very important to
emphasize this fact that Muslim men and women are required. It is an obligatory
duty for them to go to the Friday prayer.
Now, there are certain conditions for the Friday prayer. The people dress nicely as
commanded in the Quran, and they go for the noon prayer on Friday to the mosque.
And the Imam or the person who gives the sermon is required to follow certain
traditions. These are religious traditions or duties that came to us all
the way from Abraham and it is universal. This is the way it is happening all over the world.
The first condition is that throughout
the prayer from the beginning to the end, you mention only the name of God, ALLAH
SUBHANAHU WA TA'ALA in the AZAN. The AZAN should be ALLAH-O AKBAR, ALLAH-O AKBAR
ALLAH-O AKBAR, ALLAH-O AKBAR, La Elaha Ella Allah. This is the AZAN.
Now, the AZAN should be ALLAH-O AKBAR, ALLAH-O AKBAR
ALLAH-O AKBAR, ALLAH-O AKBAR, La Elaha Ella Allah. This is the AZAN. So, the AZAN or the call for
contact prayer is delivered. Then, the Imam stands up in front of the
congregation and he starts the first sermon by saying ALHAMDU LILLAH.
This is the first requirement. Now, you notice I said the first sermon,
because the KHUTBA or sermon on Friday consists of two sections or two sermons.
The prayer itself consists of two RAKATs, instead of four. The customary noon prayer
consists of four RAKATs or four units but on Friday, it is only two
RAKATs or two units and this is because the two sermons compensate for two
RAKATs or two units. So, the first sermon and also the second sermon, they must
begin by stating ALHAMDU LILLAH, praise be to God, followed by the SHAHADA.
And the SHAHADA, as dictated in the Quran, in SURA number 3 verse 81, the SHAHADA is
La Elaha Ella Allah. That's it. So, the Imam stands up and he begins
each sermon the first one and the second one by saying ALHAMDU LILLAH. La Elaha Ella Allah.
Then, he goes into the sermon, the subject in any language that he wishes.
Of course, in this country in the united states, it'll be English,
so the people will understand. If the Imam, during the sermon, uses Quran in Arabic,
he must translate it, so the people will understand. This is the whole idea of a sermon.
The sermon also deals with the local conditions of the local community.
Or it can deal with a general lesson from the Quran or a general religious lesson.
So, let me write for you the first requirement
which is stating ALHAMDU LILLAH. La Elaha Ella Allah. at the beginning of each sermon.
The Imam stands up for the sermon and the first thing he
says in the first sermon and the second sermon is ALHAMDU LILLAH. This is how it looks in writing.
AL-Hamdu Lillah,
which means praise be to God.
La Elaha Ella Allah, which looks like this. La means no.
Elaha means god with a small g.
La Elaha Ella, except
Ella Allah.
La Elaha Ella Allah. There is no god except Allah.
This is the required utterance at the beginning of the first sermon and the
second sermon. After this, you go into the subject of your sermon. Now, you notice
I didn't say anything else. This is what you start with. ALHAMDU LILLAH. La Elaha Ella Allah.
You don't start with BISMI ALLAH AL-RAHMAN AL-RAHIM, or dear

fish came into existence in this water.

millions of years were required for some of these land creatures to develop wings

Now, during the last 100 years of scientific revolution, we learned quite a few things.

As scientists, we had to modify the original theory of evolution as written

throughout Quran tell us that people believe in God. Satan believes in God, but

our acceptance of whatever is happening to you personally, or in the world,
to anybody, to anything, to any country.

unnourished soul

You guarantee success in this world

not because you're doing Him a favor
because you are doing you a favor.

because you need it,
because you need to feed your soul.

as of now

you will not hurt anyone

that as of now, there will be no sin
that you're gonna be a perfect human being.

40 years of research, looking around, studying and then, deciding,

is going to Heaven.

Why does he go to Heaven? you know
But God is Merciful beyond our wildest imagination.
And God decided that He wants to give us 40 years
to look around and study
and thank God, you know, thinking of myself
and many other, my friends who barely made it, you know
before the 40 years were up.
God is Merciful

after this

If you know

if you look at it,

God intervened.

this time with the beautiful quotation from the Bible,
from Luke 12: 29-31.

and the rest will follow, in turn.

Otherwise, you don't really care.
You're not seeking God's kingship over you,
to be sitting within, say 50 miles,
and there's a Quranic study going on.

you make a point of giving out the ZAKAT charity
as commanded by God.

one day in the year, whatever, January first, December 31st, the first day of Ramadan, any day you set for yourself,
one day in the year, you calculate exactly how much you are worth
and you give out 2.5% to people that you know personally,
people who need your charity.

your parents, first. If they don't need it, then your relatives
your cousins, your brothers, sisters.
I mean your genetic brothers and sisters.

children who have no support
one of the parents is missing somehow
and after that, the traveling stranger.

or you know personally
people who immigrated from Thailand or Vietnam and they're living in a house in a terrible conditions and you know them.

You give priority to Hajj eventually
not now. I wouldn't advise you to do it now.

You must be an example of a person of God,
one, a member in God's kingdom.

You give priority to these activities, the commands of God
and this way you seek God's kingship over you
and this way you attain all other goals:
money, health, wealth, happiness, etc., etc.

our lives and today I'm going to share with you the commandments dealing with marriage
There are two requirements that must be fulfilled.
for two people to get married and these are number one is love and we see this in SURAH 4 verse 24.

the ones that you like, you get married to. So, love must exist between the two and this cannot happen without

the person. You cannot love a person without knowing that person. So, this calls for a period
of acquaintance, getting to know each other and then based on that knowledge, you either
love the person or not and God tells you if you love the person then you get married.
God says that if this is the person intended for you, God will
put love in your hearts and this is SURAH 30 verse 21.

cause

segments.text: Sheikh Al-Banna had a particular slot on Cairo radio where he read the Quran.
All the others were changed. The times, the dates changed but not sheikh Al-Banna. He always recited
Quran at six o'clock in the morning every Tuesday on Cairo radio for as long as I
lived in Egypt and after that. So, here I have a time, six o'clock in the morning, and the day
Tuesday. OK. So, I went to Mecca for, for the pilgrimage. My parents were with me and we
prayed the morning, the Fajr at the Kaaba and then we came back to our room.
and I was preparing... that was Tuesday... I was preparing to hear my favorite reciter on Cairo radio.
So, I got my little radio and I sat in bed. My father, my mother sat in the same room in
their beds and I turned the radio to Cairo and sure enough, here comes sheikh Al-Banna and I can tell you
the reason I know I was fully awake is I never never never never fall asleep when sheikh Al-Banna is reading
Quran. And when I... when I went for Hajj from here, I took with me a hundred cassette tapes and I gave them to my
brother Atef and I told him, specifically, I want you to record anything that Al-Banna comes
whenever it comes on the radio or the TV or anything, record it. This hundred tapes. I want them full
of recitations of sheikh Al-Banna. OK. So, in Mecca now... back to Mecca, Tuesday, I'm sitting in my bed
turning the radio to Cairo radio. There comes sheikh Al-Banna and he recites SURAT Al-Rahman
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
(55:2) عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
(55:3) خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
and I am in ecstasy.
and then, I didn't hear Al-Banna anymore. I was taken to some place in the universe
and I... and I know I was fully awake but here I am somewhere and I saw these... at the time
nothing was explained to me. It is none of your business now but you are here
for some reason. And I was... I saw... all I was told was that these are all the Prophets: Jesus, Moses
Muhammad, David, Solomon, Jonah, Lot, Noah, all of them. I was told this is all of them and they
appeared like those oval pictures that many of us have, except these are alive people that people...

if God showed them to me in any other way and they have their different dresses, different
turbans and different robes but the person was ovally was down from, like, the head to
the knees. And one by one... they came in one by one and they looked straight in my face and they shake their
heads approvingly. Something like this, approvingly. And then the person would go like that.
And another one will come this way and so on. They kept going like this and I didn't know which is which.
Only Abraham was identified to me. When Abraham came, I was told this is Abraham.
And he's the only one identified to me and I didn't know what this was all about. Then, this ended. And when I
came back, I looked at my father and I said guess what! I just... I just met all the prophets and Abraham
was identified to me and he looks like us. Because it struck me, the resemblance, I remember what
they look like. Well, I can't tell which is which. So, I told him Abraham looks like
us, the Khalifas, you know what I mean. Look at me. Look at my brother. Look at my sister. There's a particular look and

that this is in fulfillment of this verse. That in retrospect what happened was that God took the

segments.text: BISM ALLAH, ALRAHMAN, ALRAHIM
In the Name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
I seek refuge in God from Satan
I have a lot to say.
I don't know why but it all came to my head.
And it is very important.
Actually, I had a lot to say and I was anxious to change the schedule.
So, when we were ahead of the schedule in the morning and Shahnaz was speaking here.
We decided to change the schedule, right?
But this is destiny.
It is destined that I speak now at this time with you, certain people, in this hall, now.
Because when we attempted to change the schedule. What happened?
We couldn't do it.
And the rain was only here around the... on the dining hall.
It was rain here only. The rain and the lightening were only here.
So, we had to go back to the original schedule because it is destiny that I speak now.
When you go to school, and enroll in a course and they find that you are deficient in some information,
they send you back to school to take some prerequisites.
You go and take physics or physical chemistry, and then you find the formulae or formulas
that how things go, differentiation and integration and funny signs.
And you don't understand a thing and they say oh you didn't take calculus?
You say no. So, they send you back to school, say go take some calculus and come back.
And we are, this is what happened to us.
We were in God's kingdom and some deficiency was discovered in us.
And some fellow creatures suggested that we'd be flunk, failed and send them all to hell.
And God said I am gonna send them back to school, give them a textbook
You see the textbook.
And then they are tested, and if they make it, they can come back.
Go take some calculus and come back.
After making this statement, I'm realizing that we are here in school to take some additional courses.
We are receiving a lot of information and we are going from test to test.
I want to congratulate you, most of you, for making it
because you have passed the most difficult test.
The most difficult test is to have one of us, a human being like us, claim that he is a messenger of God.
It's a very difficult test.
And I can see now why God calls them AS-SABEGHOON, those who are the elite of the elite,
السّابقون السّابقون the elite of the elite.
But it's a very difficult test, and I myself went through it. So, I am speaking from experience.
God says they are ثلة من الأولين, many from the first generation.
We are the first generation.
وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الآخِرِينَ and few from the later generations.
We are the ones who took the difficult test.
Many will be jumping on the wagon in the near future and thousand and millions are going to join us in the future,
but they don't deserve as much credit as you.

And Farima and Amir, like myself, who grew up with the traditional Islam:
they taught us that Muhammad was the last prophet, the last messenger,
but Farima and Amir passed the test,
and they accepted me as God's messenger. They looked at the evidence,
And they believed me.
They actually believed God,
Because God said لَا يَمَسُّهُ إِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُون
God said, none can touch this book of mine except those who are worthy of it.
And they said since God revealed the miracle of Quran through this man, then he must be, he cannot be a liar.
And they concluded that God is telling the truth.
It's not as easy as I am telling you now. But it's a difficult test. They passed it very easily.
A couple of days later, after I stayed with Farima and Amir,
the neighborhood children came to ask what is that messenger of God.
Because Farima and Amir's children went around saying guess who is sleeping in our house?
For the children, for the new generation-
Now God says He promises الحسنة, the beauty and enjoyment and Heaven for all of the believers,
But Farima and Amir's children cannot get the same credit as Farima and Amir.
These are children. They are growing up. They have no hang-ups.
They say... their parents say this is God's messenger and we believe it and for them it's easy.
Can you see the difference?
So, I congratulate you. The test is very difficult.
And I said, I passed it.
I mean I went through it.
Alhamdulillah, I did pass it because I am like you. We are in the same boat.
I am required also to believe that Rashad Khalifa is a messenger of God,
and it took me 8 years.
Some of you are probably better than me in that respect. It didn't take you that long, but it took me eight years.
And this gives me a chance to make it up to some of my most beloved friends.
Edip, where is Edip?
This man is the most curious creature on earth.
He is very curious. He knows your grandmother's name by now.
You might not know that he knows, but he is very curious.
and he comes to me and
I mean he goes to the supermarket and reads all the pamphlets and all the bulletin boards, everything, is very curious.
It doesn't make it easy when he comes to me and says how does the revelation come to you?
Do you see Gabriel?
What does he tell you? what do you tell him? In what form?
And it is very difficult to convey this to him, and I can see the disappointment in his face.
He is very dear to me because he is a believer.
Feroz Karmally is also very curious person.
Batool will tell you that.
Very curious and he asked me the same question.
And he is, he is very very dear to me, Feroz Karmally
and the disappointment in his face just breaks my heart.
I don't know how, what to tell him, so I am going to tell you now.
I see the disappointment on Edip's face and I see it in Feroz's face.
I don't know if I can satisfy their curiosity or not, but I try.
There is a precedent in the Quran, as you know Gabriel appeared to Maryam.
He told her he was Gabriel, but what did she say?
She said, إني أعوذ بالرحمن منك
I seek refuge in God from you.
إن كنت تقيا
So, she assumed that he is Satan or an agent of Satan or something bad.
And before we jump to any conclusions, I want to set some records straight. Gabriel is a messenger of God.
He is the messenger who carries the revelations, he is an angel and God calls him روح الامین
